title: Getting Started
description: Learn how to get started with FinInsights.

items.title: Create an Account
items.description: Register using your email address and create a secure password.

items.title: Verify Email
items.description: Enter the OTP sent to your registered email to activate your account.

items.title: Login
items.description: Sign in securely using your registered credentials.

items.title: Search Investments
items.description: Search Mutual Funds or Stocks from the dashboard.

items.title: Save Favourites
items.description: Add your preferred Mutual Funds and Stocks to your favourites list.

items.title: Search Funds
items.description: Find Mutual Funds using fund names.

items.title: Historical NAV
items.description: View NAV trends for any selected date range.

items.title: Latest NAV
items.description: Check the latest available NAV.

items.title: Compare Funds
items.description: Compare multiple funds side by side.

items.title: AI Analysis
items.description: Generate AI-powered analysis of a selected Mutual Fund.

items.title: Email Favourites
items.description: Email your saved favourites using Emailium.

items.title: Search Stocks
items.description: Search stocks by company name or ticker.

items.title: Company Details
items.description: View company information and market details.

items.title: Latest Market Price
items.description: Check the latest stock price.

items.title: Market Summary
items.description: View important financial indicators.

items.title: Country Selection
items.description: Select a country to view relevant market news.

items.title: Latest Articles
items.description: Read the latest investment news.

items.title: Expand News
items.description: Open complete news details including image and description.

items.title: Fund Analysis
items.description: Generate AI summaries for Mutual Funds.

items.title: Compare Funds
items.description: Generate AI comparison between selected funds.

items.title: Disclaimer
items.description: AI responses are informational only and should not be treated as financial advice.

items.title: Password Security
items.description: Passwords are securely encrypted before storage.

items.title: JWT Authentication
items.description: All authenticated requests use JWT tokens.

items.title: OTP Verification
items.description: OTP verification helps protect your account.

items.title: I didn't receive the OTP
items.description: Check your Spam folder or request a new OTP.

items.title: Why is AI taking time?
items.description: AI responses depend on external AI services and internet latency.

items.title: Can I trust AI suggestions?
items.description: Use AI responses as guidance only. Always perform your own research.

items.title: Why can't I login?
items.description: Ensure your email has been verified and your password is correct.

items.title: Support
items.description: Reach out using the Contact Us page.

items.title: Response Time
items.description: Typical response time is within 24 business hours.

items.title: Feedback
items.description: Your feedback helps improve FinInsights.

items.title: Purpose
items.description: FinInsights helps users explore Mutual Funds, Stocks, News, and AI-powered investment insights.

items.title: Technology
items.description: Built using Angular, .NET 8, Azure SQL, Render, Vercel, OpenAI, Finnhub, Alpha Vantage, and MarketAux APIs.

items.title: Version
items.description: FinInsights v1.0
